scope: Continuous rate equations and source-range diagnostic. A rate step is not the individual EPSC train of an electrical stimulation experiment. Frozen resources match the actual state, basal and instantaneous onset at the split; no independent gain fitting. Different future history can distinguish resource depletion from static amplitude. No nS-to-CNS-current calibration, no neuron-by-neuron tuning, no threshold/gain change, no stage admission.
